notes: Bay Area Reporter, 3 January 2002 to 25 December 2003, 104 weekly issues, read from the Internet Archive's DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: 2004 and 2005 remain: 83 issues in the collection, January 2004 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 104 issues; 12,127 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 933 windows after the advertisement filter (457 of them rescued for an event word) in 847 address clusters, of which 379 hold an event word; the tighter filter left 100, all read; plus 712 event-word passages, of which the 28 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 29 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 25 resolved and published, on 22 pages, none seeded. 4 held as single facts on parcels with no page: two commercial units of the 2002 condominium building at Market and 15th streets (2187 and 2189 Market), 525 Harrison and 511 Harrison. The audit flags 2 of 29: the number 400 Castro for Diesel, which the article gives only as the corner (the issue of 3 July 2003 prints it, as the placement note says), and the 1,050 square feet at 4126 18th Street, which is further on in the same story than the cited passage.
